visual_name: Day in the life, part fourteen: it's on a sticky note (low-poly 3D)
code_name: three.js office cubicle with multiplying then falling sticky notes, box-built character, today list / cork board / Home page / one big note, a lock-screen deadline, hard cuts on voiceover word times
summary: A 39.1 second 9:16 reel in low-poly 3D: six brands, each wanting something today, written on sticky notes that take over the cubicle; a change in an unopened email and a missed deadline for a brand he forgot he had; then YourBrand's Home: next step, live campaigns, posts per day on the card. The notes fall. The one he finds says 'check sticky notes'.
